decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 3 - The carrying out of repairs, maintenance or other works to any vehicle, or the storage of vehicles or of parts, shall not take place outside of the building hereby permitted.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for MOT testing centre  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 1800 hours Saturday to 0800 Monday and at no time on public holidays.

Condition : 5 - The building shall be [constructed/adapted] so as to provide sound insulation against internally generated noise of not less than 25 dB(A) with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided.
description: Change of use from (B1) light industrial to (B2) MOT centre.
